title: Seelex workflow plan state
description: Runtime state of an active WorkPlan DAG, delivered via session snapshot runtime.plan. Front-end renders this as a directed graph with status-colored nodes.

status.description: Overall plan execution status. Controls the plan-level header color.

progress.description: Completion ratio 0.0–1.0. Drives the overall progress bar.

elapsed.description: Wall-clock duration since plan execution started (human-readable, e.g. '10.7s').

planNode.description: A single node in the workflow DAG. Status drives visual styling: fill color, icon, and border.

label.description: Human-readable display name. Falls back to id when absent.

kind.description: Node execution type. Determines icon and behavior hints.

status.description: Per-node execution state. Determines color and animation.

depth.description: BFS depth from entry node (0 = root). Used for layered layout.

output.description: Node's text output after completion. Rendered on click/hover.

planEdge.description: A directed edge connecting two nodes. Rendered as an arrow from `from` to `to`.
